craft_notes: Sthāyin: full-seal (single-line close of fire-work). Rows: row 1 (whole — never split the seal). Close: sealed (vauṣaṭ as landing). Rejected: expanding to couplet — kept single (form follows Sanskrit brevity).

lines: Then too the full poured-out, vauṣaṭ-sealed.

reads_against.argmap: What seals it? → Full oblation with vauṣaṭ closes the fire-work.
c1_essence: Full oblation with vauṣaṭ ends the fire-work.
